mission_05: Target encoding replaces each category with the mean of the target variable for that category. This is especially useful for high-cardinality categorical features where one-hot encoding would create too many columns. For example, encoding a 'city' feature with the average sales for that city captures the predictive signal in a single numeric column. However, target encoding can lead to overfitting, especially for categories with few samples. In this mission, you will implement basic target encoding and learn about smoothing techniques to reduce overfitting risk.
